title: Inhere
summary: INHE'RE, verb intransitive [Latin inhoereo; in and hoereo, to hang.] To exist or be fixed in something else; as, colors inhere in cloth; a dart inheres in the flesh.

inlines.v: INHE'RE, verb intransitive [Latin inhoereo; in and hoereo, to hang.] To exist or be fixed in something else; as, colors inhere in cloth; a dart inheres in the flesh.
